description: List a trigger's activations from the last month: activationId, duration, status, plus totalCount

end.description: End of the window as a Unix timestamp in MILLISECONDS (default: now).

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

start.description: Start of the window as a Unix timestamp in MILLISECONDS (default: one month before now). Only the last month is queryable.

name: ncloud_functions_get_trigger_activations
